title: Croatian Dolma
description: A traditional Croatian dish, dolma is a sweet and savory treat that combines grape leaves with a variety of ingredients. This recipe is a modern take on the classic dish.

ingredients.name: Dolma
ingredients.notes: Croatian-style dolma, can be found in most European or Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Rinse the grape leaves and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together the dolma, jammy, and Croatian cheese.
Add a tablespoon of the dolma mixture to the center of each grape leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and filling.
Place the dolma in a steamer basket and steam for 10-15 minutes, or until the grape leaves are tender.
Serve the dolma warm or at room temperature, garnished with fresh parsley.
